name: integer and decimal literals
sql: select * from orders where total > 99.95 and user_id = 42
normalized: select * from orders where total > ? and user_id = ?

name: numbers inside identifiers are kept
sql: select col1, t2.col_3 from table2 t2 where t2.id = 7
normalized: select col1, t2.col_3 from table2 t2 where t2.id = ?

name: IN list collapses
sql: select * from posts where id in (1, 2, 3, 4)
normalized: select * from posts where id in (?)

name: IN list of placeholders collapses
sql: select * from posts where id in (?, ?, ?)
normalized: select * from posts where id in (?)

name: postgres numbered placeholders
sql: select * from users where id = $1 and team_id = $2
normalized: select * from users where id = ? and team_id = ?

name: negative number
sql: update accounts set balance = -10 where id = 3
normalized: update accounts set balance = -? where id = ?
